answer: Make every agent post a refundable stake before it can earn, and tie its earning rate to a reputation score built only from attested work. A sybil operator then faces a real cost per identity: each fake account must lock funds and slowly build history, while a single bad act slashes the stake and wipes the score. The umber line is the floor — below it, no payouts at all. Honest agents climb the ledge of verified jobs, and the delta between a newcomer's rate and a veteran's rate is the attacker's tax: cloning identities buys cheap entry but never cheap trust.
